thread:
mei: FYI I opened a docs PR that adds a condensed Optimize toolkit migration checklist: batching, KV prefetch, and a new quant profile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912

harpreet: nice. Do we have a short note about short-sequence streaming regressions when prefix cache is enabled? We hit that in the replay tests.

mei: included — callout suggests disabling prefix cache for avg seq len <= 8 and lowering prefetch_window_ms to 10-20ms for chatty workloads.

mei: pasted the minimal CLI eval snippet I added to the checklist so folks can run a quick regression locally:

./tools/eval_small.sh --prompts examples/short_and_long_prompts.json --profile q4-adaptive-v2 --baseline q4-old --out /tmp/eval.json
jq '.metrics | {ppl_change: .ppl.delta, tok_hist: .token_length.histogram[:10]}' /tmp/eval.json

harpreet: can we recommend sample sizes? maybe 500 short and 200 long per service for a quick sanity check.

dylan: LGTM — I also tweaked wording to make the rollout steps explicit: local eval -> canary (5%) -> ramp (25%) -> full. Added a reminder to pin quant_profile in the service config during rollout.

preview-bot: preview build for PR 912 finished with 1 warning (image missing alt text).

mei: fixed alt text and swapped to CDN image. Also added a tiny Go SDK snippet mapping fields to OptimizeConfig to ensure cross-language parity.

ops-bot: note: alerting runbook updated to include the latency regressions dashboard when changing quant_profile (doc link updated).

harpreet: left two nits in the PR comments about phrasing. nothing blocking.

mei: addressed nits, rebased and pushing. Merge when green. I'll ping #eng-runtime after the merge with the TL;DR and links to sample-app updates.

dylan: great, thanks for pulling this together.

mei: merging now. :shipit:
